_README: Token price table used by agent/metrics.py to convert measured token counts
into a USD cost per turn. Prices are an OPERATOR-SUPPLIED ASSUMPTION, not a
measurement — re-verify against the provider's current pricing page before
quoting any cost number, and bump `as_of` when you do.
A model that is absent from `models` yields cost_usd = null (NOT 0.0), so an
unpriced model can never be silently reported as free.

gemma-4-31b-it.note: ACTUAL finalizer model per .env (AGENT_FINAL_MODEL). Open-weights model served free on Google AI Studio; priced at 0 here. This is exactly why the two-model split looks cheap - see counterfactual_model below before claiming a saving.

gemma-3-27b-it.note: code default in AgentConfig.final_model; same free-tier reasoning as above

counterfactual_note: eval/aggregate_metrics.py reprices EVERY token (router + finalizer) at
counterfactual_model to answer: what would this cost as a single-model agent?
The reported saving is (counterfactual - actual) / counterfactual.
With gemma priced at 0 the saving is trivially the finalizer's whole share, so
the token-share breakdown is the honest headline number, not the dollar figure.
